datasets.name: 05_cp_shift_comparison
queryLines:
WITH shift_data AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    queue_name,
    port,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN
        transaction_hour >= 6
        AND transaction_hour < 18
      THEN
        'Day Shift'
      ELSE 'Night Shift'
    END AS shift_name,
    CASE
      WHEN transaction_hour < 6 THEN DATE_SUB(transaction_date, 1)
      ELSE transaction_date
    END AS shift_date
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
)
SELECT
  shift_name,
  queue_name,
  SUM(vehicle_in) AS total_vehicle_in,
  SUM(vehicle_out) AS total_vehicle_out,
  SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
  AVG(total_tonnage) AS avg_tph,
  AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_area_duration_minutes
FROM
  shift_data
GROUP BY
  shift_name,
  queue_name

datasets.name: 05_cp_realtime_monitoring
queryLines:
WITH latest_hourly AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    total_transaction,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY queue_name
        ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_hour DESC
      ) as rn
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
),
cp_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    vehicle_in - vehicle_out AS estimated_queue_length,
    vehicle_in - vehicle_out AS estimated_active_units,
    total_tonnage AS tph,
    100.0 AS installed_capacity_tph,
    (total_tonnage / 100.0) * 100 AS utilization_percentage,
    CASE
      WHEN (vehicle_in - vehicle_out) > 8 THEN 'ALERT'
      ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS alert_status,
    vehicle_in AS total_vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out AS total_vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes
  FROM
    latest_hourly
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  cp_metrics

datasets.name: 05_cp_kpi_summary
queryLines:
WITH latest_data AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT queue_name) AS total_cp_monitored,
    SUM(total_vehicle_in) AS total_vehicle_in,
    SUM(total_vehicle_out) AS total_vehicle_out,
    SUM(total_transaction) AS total_transaction,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
    AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_area_duration,
    SUM(anomaly_count) AS anomaly_count,
    SUM(data_quality_issue_count) AS data_quality_issue_count
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_daily_summary`
),
queue_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vehicle_in - vehicle_out) AS total_queue_length,
    SUM(vehicle_in - vehicle_out) AS total_active_units,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (vehicle_in - vehicle_out) > 8 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS alert_count,
    AVG(total_tonnage) AS avg_tph
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        queue_name,
        vehicle_in,
        vehicle_out,
        total_tonnage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY queue_name
            ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_hour DESC
          ) as rn
      FROM
        `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ld.total_cp_monitored,
  COALESCE(qm.total_queue_length, 0) AS total_queue_length,
  COALESCE(qm.total_active_units, 0) AS total_active_units,
  COALESCE(qm.avg_tph, 0) AS avg_tph,
  ld.total_tonnage,
  ld.total_vehicle_in,
  ld.total_vehicle_out,
  ld.avg_cp_area_duration,
  COALESCE(qm.alert_count, 0) AS alert_count,
  ld.data_quality_issue_count
FROM
  latest_data ld CROSS JOIN queue_metrics qm

datasets.name: 05_ds_left_cp_performance
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    queue_name,
    port,
    total_transaction,
    total_vehicle,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_cp_process_duration_minutes,
    to_timestamp(
      concat(
        cast(transaction_date AS string),
        ' ',
        lpad(cast(transaction_hour AS string), 2, '0'),
        ':00:00'
      )
    ) AS period_ts
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
)
SELECT
  queue_name,
  SUM(vehicle_in) AS vehicle_in,
  SUM(vehicle_out) AS vehicle_out,
  SUM(total_transaction) AS total_transaction,
  SUM(total_vehicle) AS total_vehicle,
  SUM(total_tonnage) AS total_tonnage,
  SUM(total_tonnage)
    / GREATEST((unix_timestamp(:left_end_ts) - unix_timestamp(:left_start_ts)) / 3600.0, 1) AS tph,
  AVG(avg_queue_duration_minutes) AS avg_queue_duration_minutes,
  AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
  AVG(avg_cp_process_duration_minutes) AS avg_cp_process_duration_minutes
FROM
  base
WHERE
  :left_start_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND :left_end_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND period_ts >= :left_start_ts
  AND period_ts < :left_end_ts
GROUP BY
  queue_name
ORDER BY
  total_tonnage DESC

datasets.name: 05_ds_comparison_delta_by_cp
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_date,
    transaction_hour,
    queue_name,
    port,
    total_transaction,
    total_vehicle,
    vehicle_in,
    vehicle_out,
    total_tonnage,
    avg_queue_duration_minutes,
    avg_cp_area_duration_minutes,
    avg_cp_process_duration_minutes,
    to_timestamp(
      concat(
        cast(transaction_date AS string),
        ' ',
        lpad(cast(transaction_hour AS string), 2, '0'),
        ':00:00'
      )
    ) AS period_ts
  FROM
    `uc`.`synova`.`gold_uc05_cp_vehicle_hourly_summary`
),
left_period AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    SUM(vehicle_in) AS left_vehicle_in,
    SUM(vehicle_out) AS left_vehicle_out,
    SUM(total_transaction) AS left_total_transaction,
    SUM(total_vehicle) AS left_total_vehicle,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS left_total_tonnage,
    SUM(total_tonnage)
      / GREATEST(
        (unix_timestamp(:left_end_ts) - unix_timestamp(:left_start_ts)) / 3600.0,
        1
      ) AS left_tph,
    AVG(avg_queue_duration_minutes) AS left_avg_queue_duration,
    AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS left_avg_cp_area_duration,
    AVG(avg_cp_process_duration_minutes) AS left_avg_cp_process_duration
  FROM
    base
  WHERE
    :left_start_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND :left_end_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND period_ts >= :left_start_ts
    AND period_ts < :left_end_ts
  GROUP BY
    queue_name
),
right_period AS (
  SELECT
    queue_name,
    SUM(vehicle_in) AS right_vehicle_in,
    SUM(vehicle_out) AS right_vehicle_out,
    SUM(total_transaction) AS right_total_transaction,
    SUM(total_vehicle) AS right_total_vehicle,
    SUM(total_tonnage) AS right_total_tonnage,
    SUM(total_tonnage)
      / GREATEST(
        (unix_timestamp(:right_end_ts) - unix_timestamp(:right_start_ts)) / 3600.0,
        1
      ) AS right_tph,
    AVG(avg_queue_duration_minutes) AS right_avg_queue_duration,
    AVG(avg_cp_area_duration_minutes) AS right_avg_cp_area_duration,
    AVG(avg_cp_process_duration_minutes) AS right_avg_cp_process_duration
  FROM
    base
  WHERE
    :right_start_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND :right_end_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND period_ts >= :right_start_ts
    AND period_ts < :right_end_ts
  GROUP BY
    queue_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(l.queue_name, r.queue_name) AS queue_name,
  l.left_vehicle_in,
  r.right_vehicle_in,
  r.right_vehicle_in - l.left_vehicle_in AS delta_vehicle_in,
  CASE
    WHEN
      l.left_vehicle_in = 0
      OR l.left_vehicle_in IS NULL
    THEN
      NULL
    ELSE ((r.right_vehicle_in - l.left_vehicle_in) / l.left_vehicle_in) * 100
  END AS delta_vehicle_in_pct,
  l.left_vehicle_out,
  r.right_vehicle_out,
  r.right_vehicle_out - l.left_vehicle_out AS delta_vehicle_out,
  CASE
    WHEN
      l.left_vehicle_out = 0
      OR l.left_vehicle_out IS NULL
    THEN
      NULL
    ELSE ((r.right_vehicle_out - l.left_vehicle_out) / l.left_vehicle_out) * 100
  END AS delta_vehicle_out_pct,
  l.left_total_tonnage,
  r.right_total_tonnage,
  r.right_total_tonnage - l.left_total_tonnage AS delta_total_tonnage,
  CASE
    WHEN
      l.left_total_tonnage = 0
      OR l.left_total_tonnage IS NULL
    THEN
      NULL
    ELSE ((r.right_total_tonnage - l.left_total_tonnage) / l.left_total_tonnage) * 100
  END AS delta_total_tonnage_pct,
  l.left_tph,
  r.right_tph,
  r.right_tph - l.left_tph AS delta_tph,
  CASE
    WHEN
      l.left_tph = 0
      OR l.left_tph IS NULL
    THEN
      NULL
    ELSE ((r.right_tph - l.left_tph) / l.left_tph) * 100
  END AS delta_tph_pct,
  l.left_avg_cp_area_duration,
  r.right_avg_cp_area_duration,
  r.right_avg_cp_area_duration - l.left_avg_cp_area_duration AS delta_avg_cp_area_duration
FROM
  left_period l
    FULL OUTER JOIN right_period r
      ON l.queue_name = r.queue_name
ORDER BY
  ABS(delta_total_tonnage) DESC
